**AGENTS.md:** Exists at root. Contains development rules covering conversational style, code quality, testing anti-thrashing, commands for Rust/TypeScript, file hygiene (UTF-8 no BOM), dependency security, git guidelines, and a workspace map. Notably, it references TypeScript packages under `packages/` (ai, agent, coding-agent, tui, mcp, codemode, schema, telemetry) but that directory does **not** currently exist — the workspace is Rust-only at this time.

---

## Packages (TypeScript)

No `packages/` directory exists at root. No `package.json` files were found anywhere in the tree (excluding the `docs/handoff/gemini-coding-agent-gaps/raw/` snapshot). According to AGENTS.md's Workspace Map, the planned TypeScript packages are: `ai`, `agent`, `coding-agent`, `tui`, `mcp`, `codemode`, `schema`, `telemetry`. These are not yet checked out.

---

## Crates (Rust Workspace)

The root `Cargo.toml` defines a workspace with 10 members under `crates/`. All share workspace version `0.1.0`, edition 2021, MIT license.

| Crate | Description (from Cargo.toml / deps) | Key Dependencies |
|---|---|---|
| `mehh-ai` | AI integration layer: HTTP/LLM client with hashing, UUID, regex support. | tokio, reqwest, serde, serde_json, anyhow, uuid, base64, sha2, hmac, crc32fast, regex, async-trait |
| `mehh-agent` | Agent orchestration: async task/agent primitives built on top of mehh-ai. | mehh-ai, tokio, tokio-util, futures, async-trait, serde, serde_json |
| `mehh-tools` | Tool execution sandbox: file search/glob/regex/similarity utilities for agent tools. | mehh-ai, mehh-agent, mehh-sandbox, anyhow, tokio, async-trait, serde, base64, regex, globset, ignore, similar |
| `mehh-sandbox` | Sandbox/isolation crate (no dependencies declared). | *(none)* |
| `mehh-execpolicy` | Execution policy crate (no dependencies declared). | *(none)* |
| `mehh-coding-agent` | Core coding agent: ties together AI, agent, tools, TUI, MCP, codemode, execpolicy with filesystem ignore/glob/regex. | mehh-ai, mehh-agent, mehh-tools, mehh-tui, mehh-mcp, mehh-codemode, mehh-execpolicy, crossterm, tokio, reqwest, serde, uuid, sha2, ignore, regex, globset |
| `mehh-codemode` | Code transformation/execution mode using QuickJS (JavaScript engine embedded in Rust). | mehh-ai, mehh-agent, tokio, rquickjs (0.9), base64, serde, anyhow |
| `mehh-mcp` | Model Context Protocol server/client implementation with tracing. | mehh-ai, mehh-agent, tokio, reqwest, serde, serde_json, anyhow, sha2, tracing, base64, uuid |
| `mehh-tui` | Terminal UI rendering with crossterm, markdown (pulldown-cmark), unicode width/segmentation. | crossterm, unicode-width, unicode-segmentation, serde, serde_json, pulldown-cmark (0.12) |
| `mehh-cli` | Binary entry point `mehh` — CLI that wires together ai, agent, tools, coding-agent with clap. | mehh-ai, mehh-agent, mehh-tools, mehh-coding-agent, tokio, clap, anyhow |

---

## Tech Stack

**Primary languages:**
- **Rust** (edition 2021) — the only language currently implemented; all 10 crates are Rust.
- **TypeScript** — planned/referenced in AGENTS.md for `packages/` but not yet present in the checkout.

**Build tools:**
- `cargo` (Rust workspace) — `cargo check`, `cargo clippy`, `cargo test -p <crate>`
- `npm` / `tsc` / `vitest` — planned for TypeScript packages (node_modules currently absent; AGENTS.md notes these cannot run until workspace package naming/lockfile setup is finished)

**Test frameworks:**
- Rust: built-in `cargo test`
- TypeScript: `node:test` (for `packages/tui`), Vitest (for other packages, when hydrated)

**Linting:** Biome (planned; `biome.json` not yet restored — AGENTS.md warns against running it with defaults)

---

## Notable Configuration Files

| File | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `Cargo.toml` (root) | Present | Rust workspace manifest defining all 10 crate members and shared dependency versions |
| `Cargo.lock` | Present | Gitignored Rust lockfile |
| `tsconfig.json` | Absent | Not found anywhere in the tree |
| `biome.json` | Absent | Not found; AGENTS.md says it must be restored before running `npx biome check` |
| `package.json` | Absent | No `packages/` directory exists yet |
| `.gitignore` | Present | Covers `node_modules`, `target/`, `Cargo.lock`, `packages/*/dist/`, editor env, `.env`, Rust artifacts |
| `measure.ps1` | Present | PowerShell measurement script at root |
| `OPTIMIZE_REPORT.md` | Present | Optimization report at root |

---

### Summary

The project is a **Rust-first workspace** (`mehh-*` crates) building what appears to be an AI-powered coding agent with CLI, TUI, MCP, and tooling components. TypeScript packages are planned (referenced in AGENTS.md and `.gitignore`) but not yet checked out — there is no `packages/` directory, no `package.json`, no `tsconfig.json`, and no `biome.json` at this time. The only build system currently usable is `cargo`.
